_ai_assisted: AI-assisted: protocol structure regenerated with Codex under Edu decisions for #137; human review pending. Adapted with Codex for Edu decisions on #191; human review pending.
_integration_status: Activated for confirmed numerical findings. Immediate clinical-priority entry before measurement confirmation remains a separate owner integration; no numerical finding automatically establishes urgency.

w_red_flags.text: Sudden/rapidly worsening weakness, unsafe movement or new inability to exit, new intense muscle pain, breathing difficulty or loss of consciousness? The last two mean a general emergency, not proof of muscle loss.
w_red_flags.source: guia_tratamientos_vigilancia_urgencia.pdf (2026-11-14), p. 1; Team triage guide, muscle atrophy, medical urgency [P]

w_report.text: Tell the crew medical officer. Review together your symptoms, any pain, your real exercise load and your strength trend.
w_report.source: guia_tratamientos_vigilancia_urgencia.pdf (2026-11-14), p. 1; Team triage guide, muscle atrophy, watch: initial action [P]

w_limits.text: Is the worsening unexpected, or does it stop you from completing a task?
w_limits.source: guia_tratamientos_vigilancia_urgencia.pdf (2026-11-14), p. 1; Team triage guide, muscle atrophy, watch: initial action [P]

w_exercise.text: Review strength and aerobic exercise load, technique and recovery with your exercise specialist; do not increase the load yourself. Review energy and protein intake with the approved nutrition plan.
w_exercise.source: guia_tratamientos_vigilancia_urgencia.pdf (2026-11-14), p. 1; NASA, Exercise Overview [1]; Team triage guide [P] Management: NASA Exercise Overview [1] and NASA Human Adaptation to Spaceflight: The Role of Nutrition [2], as cited on PDF p. 2.

w_end.text: Log symptoms and training daily; repeat comparable strength tests as directed; follow prescribed recovery plan after return. No training through pain, catch-up loads, supplements or drugs without medical advice.
w_end.source: guia_tratamientos_vigilancia_urgencia.pdf (2026-11-14), p. 1; NASA, The Real Story About Astronaut Health Care in Space [3]; Canadian Space Agency, Return and Reconditioning [4]

u_stop.text: Stop exercise and risky tasks, get to a safe position and alert the crew medical officer now. Do not repeat tests at maximum effort or wait for another sensor reading.
u_stop.source: guia_tratamientos_vigilancia_urgencia.pdf (2026-11-14), p. 1; Team triage guide, muscle atrophy, medical urgency: initial action [P]

u_env.source: Edu-approved prototype workflow for #191 (2026-11-15): Earth contact required on ISS/Mars, optional on Moon; clinician-held urgency escalation and explicit insufficient-correction question. This is a team workflow decision, not a validated clinical rule.

u_orbit.text: Send the case summary to the flight surgeons (mission doctors); this app does not send it. Continue local care without waiting for Earth; the clinician decides any return or transfer.
u_orbit.source: guia_tratamientos_vigilancia_urgencia.pdf (2026-11-14), p. 1; Team triage guide, by environment [P]; NASA, The Real Story About Astronaut Health Care in Space [3] Edu-approved prototype workflow for #191 (2026-11-15): Earth contact required on ISS/Mars, optional on Moon; clinician-held urgency escalation and explicit insufficient-correction question. This is a team workflow decision, not a validated clinical rule.

u_moon.text: Continue local care in the habitat. The clinician decides any transfer according to clinical need, vehicle and resources.
u_moon.source: Edu-approved lunar routing for #191: local care continues when Earth support is not requested; no automatic transfer.

u_mars_send.text: Send the case summary to the flight surgeons (mission doctors); this app does not send it. Continue local care without waiting for Earth; the clinician decides any return or transfer.
u_mars_send.source: guia_tratamientos_vigilancia_urgencia.pdf (2026-11-14), p. 1; Team triage guide, by environment [P]; NASA, Hazard: Distance From Earth [7] Edu-approved prototype workflow for #191 (2026-11-15): Earth contact required on ISS/Mars, optional on Moon; clinician-held urgency escalation and explicit insufficient-correction question. This is a team workflow decision, not a validated clinical rule.

u_end.text: Clinician review and transfer of care are recorded; follow medical limits and recovery plan for the condition found. Return or transfer depends on clinical need, vehicle and resources, not just a sensor value.
u_end.source: guia_tratamientos_vigilancia_urgencia.pdf (2026-11-14), p. 1; Team triage guide, muscle atrophy, medical urgency: follow-up [P]

u_help.text: Request immediate assistance from the crew medical officer. Do not continue the risky task.

w_concern.source: guia_tratamientos_vigilancia_urgencia.pdf (2026-11-14), pp. 1-2; numerical concern requires priority review without automatic medical urgency [P].

w_priority_review.text: Ask the crew medical officer for priority review of the concerning finding or unexpected task limitation. A concerning number alone does not establish medical urgency.

u_local.text: Alert the on-board medical lead for immediate assessment and care to stabilize you; check for injury or another sudden cause. Follow the local emergency protocol without waiting for Earth.

u_support.text: Has the local clinician requested Earth support while local care continues?
u_support.source: Edu-approved prototype workflow for #191 (2026-11-15): Earth contact required on ISS/Mars, optional on Moon; clinician-held urgency escalation and explicit insufficient-correction question. This is a team workflow decision, not a validated clinical rule. Legacy node retained; now used for optional lunar Earth support.

u_handover.text: Confirm that a clinician has reviewed this episode and accepted responsibility for ongoing care. Select Done only then; otherwise keep this task active and stay assisted.

w_review_outcome.text: Wait here until the clinician completes the priority review. Has the clinician declared a medical urgency?
w_review_outcome.source: Edu-approved prototype workflow for #191 (2026-11-15): Earth contact required on ISS/Mars, optional on Moon; clinician-held urgency escalation and explicit insufficient-correction question. This is a team workflow decision, not a validated clinical rule.

u_no_clinician.text: Keep risky tasks stopped and follow your pre-authorized local emergency protocol without waiting for Earth. This episode stays open until a clinician reviews it and accepts care.
u_no_clinician.source: guia_tratamientos_vigilancia_urgencia.pdf (2026-11-14), p. 1; existing approved u_stop, u_local, u_mars_send and u_handover instructions: stop risky tasks, local pre-authorized emergency protocol without waiting for Earth, and clinician-accepted handover. #217 prototype flow composition [P]: show these existing instructions when handover cannot be accepted, then return to the open handover task. No new treatment, alternate clinician role, timer or autonomous closure.
